_doc: Bloodlines (FAM-007): rare inheritable traits that lie dormant until their bearer reaches awaken_realm, then grant bonuses. A child inherits a parent's bloodline with inherit_chance_one (one parent carries it) or inherit_chance_both (both parents carry the same one); if the parents carry different bloodlines, each is tried in random order. A child who inherits nothing may still be born with one: each bloodline's 'rarity' (0..1) is its chance per birth. Named NPCs can carry one via npcs.json 'bloodline'; generated courtship candidates roll family.json eligible_npcs.bloodline_chance (then a bloodline weighted by rarity); the 'bloodline' effect key grants one to someone without one (encounters, items). Per bloodline: id, name, description, rarity, awaken_realm (realm id), bonuses: qi_mult (extra cultivation speed fraction), breakthrough (flat breakthrough chance), max_hp/attack/defense/speed (combat stat fractions, e.g. 0.1 = +10%). Bonuses may be negative (a price paid for power).

bloodlines.name: Azure Dragon Bloodline
bloodlines.description: A trace of the Azure Dragon of the East. Its bearers' qi surges like spring rivers.

bloodlines.name: Vermilion Phoenix Bloodline
bloodlines.description: Phoenix fire sleeps in the blood. Its bearers rise from every setback stronger.

bloodlines.name: White Tiger Bloodline
bloodlines.description: The killing intent of the White Tiger of the West. Born warriors.

bloodlines.name: Black Tortoise Bloodline
bloodlines.description: The patience of the Black Tortoise of the North. Hard to wound, harder to kill.

bloodlines.name: Qilin Bloodline
bloodlines.description: The blood of the benevolent Qilin, beast of good omen. Heaven smiles on its bearers' breakthroughs.

bloodlines.name: Nine-Tailed Fox Bloodline
bloodlines.description: A sliver of the Nine-Tailed Celestial Fox. Its bearers are quick, clever and hard to pin down.

bloodlines.name: Golden Crow Bloodline
bloodlines.description: The sun-fire of the three-legged Golden Crow. It slumbers long, then burns everything.

bloodlines.name: Blood Asura Bloodline
bloodlines.description: The battle-madness of the Blood Asura, a demon race that bathed in slaughter. Mighty, but the heart demons whisper louder.
